made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/sombrilla-sheet-make.js, from sombrilla-set.html (window.SOMBRILLA.E and FACE_AT) and the design of La sombrilla (the orchestrator's p7-spec, section sombrilla). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 64. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the water's edge at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 64 + 13 v - 22.5 z; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62 and v (on the sand) from -4.92 to 11.69
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the sand; the blanket's top is z .03, under 1 px: the spec's z 0 is kept) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): the bucket, the row of three spiral shells and the three things in the row have their bottom middle on the spot; a shell of the face is centred on its place (the touch box of the place is things.<name>, 14 x 10). The ball has no spot: it is held (the preview draws it at Luis's side). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 41 rows drawn standing for a child (Luis, Carmen); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51, engine.js): column 30; abuela sitting on the blanket: mkAbuelaS (52 x 50) with pies (her legs out in front, to the right), column 17 and her lowest drawn row on sy; abuela lying: a plain stand-in (52 x 18, no maker yet: the spec gives no size), her middle column on sx and her lowest row on sy, head at the left; Canelo mkPerro('husmea') (30 x 22), head down, sniffing or digging: column 15 and its bottom edge; a small thing: see spot. Nobody is turned (the makers draw them from the front)
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.face: ojo_izq, ojo_der, nariz, boca: 14 x 10 boxes centred on SOMBRILLA.FACE_AT (the eyes at u 0.43 and 1.67, v 4.05; the nose v 4.7; the mouth v 5.45): the box is [sx - 7, sy - 5, 14, 10]; a shell is 5 px, centred on the point
rules.figure: cabeza and cara are the boxes of their circles; brazo_izq / brazo_der: from the body to the hand along the arms' line, 6 px high; mano_izq / mano_der: 12 x 10, inner edge at the arm's end, going outward; pies: two 12 x 8 boxes, inner edge at the leg's end (u 0.5 and 1.6 at v 7.6), going outward. izq is the one at the left of the picture

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the umbrella's canopy hides whoever is behind it. Nothing in this set sways (no palm, no frond), so the baked depth is the whole depth.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as La plaza's sheets: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the sand (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28, the dog .3) (open point)
shadows.lying: abuela lying casts none of her own: she is in the umbrella's shade
